prompts.prompt: For Apache Druid, what is the recommended target size range, in megabytes, for a single segment on disk? Answer with both numbers.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/druid/SKILL.md - Segment sizing best practices: Target 300-700 MB per segment on disk (also target 3-5 million rows per segment).

prompts.prompt: In Apache Druid 36.x, what is the name of the new autoScalerStrategy value that lets Kafka supervisor autoscaling balance resource cost against lag, rather than relying only on lag thresholds? Answer with the exact setting value.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/druid/references/versions/36.x.md - Cost-Based Autoscaling for Streaming Ingestion table: autoScalerStrategy costBased (36.x new) optimizes task count balancing lag vs resource cost.
